title: Purifying the Heart from Negativity
arabic: اللهم طهر قلبي من كل سوء ، اللهم طهر قلبي من كل ما يبغضك، اللهم طهر قلبي من كل غلٍ وحقدٍ وحسد وكبر
translation: Oh Allah, clean away all forms of evil from my heart. Oh Allah, clean my heart and remove everything that displeases You. Oh Allah, clean my heart of every form of bitterness, hard feelings, and jealousy.
reference: A personal supplication rooted in Islamic teachings of spiritual purification (Tazkiyah)
